items: F1: time-zone-independent expectations in the inherited go-utils timeutil tests

root_cause.production_contract: UnixMilliToStringPtr, TimeToTimeString and TimeToDateString format with tm.In(GetDefaultTimeLocation()).Format(...), and DefaultTimeLocationName is Asia/Shanghai (pkg/localdeps/go-utils/timeutil/consts.go:10, trans.go:36/133/172)
root_cause.broken_expectations: the three cases built their expectation from the running process: time.UnixMilli(now).Format(TimeLayout) and now.Format(TimeLayout/DateLayout), i.e. the runner's local zone
root_cause.why_it_only_failed_on_ci: the development host is Asia/Shanghai (readlink /etc/localtime -> /usr/share/zoneinfo/Asia/Shanghai, date shows CST +08:00), so local and expected coincide; GitHub Actions runners are UTC, so the clock was 8 hours apart
root_cause.not_a_fix: forcing TZ=Asia/Shanghai for CI, skipping or deleting the cases, editing production timeutil, or normalising output globally - none of those was done

sites: TestUnixMilliToStringPtr: input is the fixed instant 1678245350773 (2023-03-08 03:15:50.773 UTC) and the expectation is the literal Asia/Shanghai wall clock 2023-03-08 11:15:50
TestTimeToTimeString: fixed instant time.Date(2024,2,3,4,5,6,0,time.UTC) against the literal 2024-02-03 12:05:06
TestTimeToDateString (same latent class, did not happen to fail in the CI window): fixed instant 2024-02-03 20:30 UTC, whose UTC date and Asia/Shanghai date differ, against the literal 2024-02-04
kept: every nil-input case in the three tests is retained and still asserted
no test was deleted, skipped, renamed or given a looser assertion; the expectations got strictly more specific (a literal string instead of a value recomputed from the runner clock)
the invalid-input and empty-string cases in the neighbouring tests were not touched
patch.production_files: trans.go, consts.go, range.go, diff.go, format.go and their tests show zero diff; trans.go was hash-verified byte-identical before and after the mutation control below

verification.environment: GOROOT=/home/ubuntu/sdk/go1.26.7 (go1.26.7 linux/amd64), GOTOOLCHAIN=local, GOWORK=off, explicit -mod=readonly, -count=1 so no result is served from the test cache

before_after_control_on_the_baseline_fil.method: git show b48dc44:<trans_test.go> was dropped into the working tree, the tests run, and the fixed file restored (git diff afterwards shows only the intended 17/18 change)
before_after_control_on_the_baseline_fil.TZ=UTC: exit 1 - TestUnixMilliToStringPtr and TestTimeToTimeString fail with expected 15:54:06 / actual 23:54:06, the same 8-hour gap CI reported; TestTimeToDateString passed at that wall-clock minute
before_after_control_on_the_baseline_fil.TZ=Asia/Shanghai: exit 0 - which is exactly why the bug survived local development
before_after_control_on_the_baseline_fil.TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati_on_the_untouched_d: exit 1 - baseline TestTimeToDateString fails with expected 2026-09-27 / actual 2026-09-26, proving the third site is the same latent class and not a speculative rewrite

assertions_are_not_vacuous.mutation: trans.go: the three .In(GetDefaultTimeLocation()) call sites replaced by .In(time.UTC) in the working tree only
assertions_are_not_vacuous.result: TZ=UTC exit 1 and TZ=Asia/Shanghai exit 1, all three cases failing with the 8-hour gap in both zones
assertions_are_not_vacuous.restore: cp back from the saved pristine copy; sha256 7873d62bc33d596685c32832ec0ee2afc67216ce9077b9a383c92452c4298ccc identical before and after (f1-mutation-*.sha256), and the mutation was never committed

other_real_failures_recorded_not_removed.case: TestTimeDifferenceDays (pkg/localdeps/go-utils/timeutil/diff_test.go:39) fails under TZ=America/New_York with expected 192 / actual 191
other_real_failures_recorded_not_removed.cause: DayTimeDifferenceHours builds both day boundaries in time.Local and TimeDifferenceDays ceilings the hour count, so a spring-forward day of 23 hours inside the interval rounds up a day; the 2018-03-11 US DST start is inside the asserted interval
other_real_failures_recorded_not_removed.status: out of F1 scope and left as-is: fixing it would mean changing production timeutil semantics (forbidden here) or recomputing the expectation from the runner (the loosening F1 forbids). It does not fire on the UTC CI runner or on this Asia/Shanghai host, and no DST-free zone tested here triggers it (UTC, Asia/Shanghai, Australia/Sydney, Pacific/Kiritimati all exit 0 over the whole package)
other_real_failures_recorded_not_removed.evidence: /home/ubuntu/tx7do-pilot-run/T15/review-fixes/f1-timeutil-America_New_York.log plus the four passing zone logs

follows: F1 is the first commit group; F2/F3/F5 (staging write-back safety and strict PGV scope) and F4 (tool identity) come next, then one full make verify-gpu on the fixed candidate
